deals.notes: The meeting of December 7, 2020 was adjourned (425 of 2020-12-14: 'The meeting has been adjourned to allow shareholder more time to vote.'). The 425 of 2021-01-15 gives a further adjourned meeting date of February 17, 2021 for NPN; the last NPN filing shown (2021-01-21, 0001193125-21-013463) is another adjournment reminder. No filing shown states a vote result, completion or termination.
